scenes.say: You earn more than five years ago. So why aren't you richer?
Because every raise quietly upgraded your life instead of your future.
Two people start by saving {a_contrib} a year. One saves every raise too. One spends it.

scenes.big_label: the gap — from the same paycheck

scenes.say: Nobody got a better job. One just stopped buying a better-looking life.
Lifestyle inflation doesn't feel like spending. It feels like finally deserving it.
Next raise, keep at least half of it before your lifestyle notices.
You didn't get richer. Your bills just got a promotion.

takeaway: You didn't get richer. Your bills just got a promotion.
